title: Research
lead: Ask a question and get a short report that cites every claim, from your own documents and from the web (through your own search key, or DuckDuckGo if you have none). Each claim is then checked against the source it cites.

form.queryPlaceholder: e.g. How does retrieval-augmented generation reduce hallucination?
form.quickHint: Up to 5 sources, a few minutes of reading.
form.deepHint: Up to 20 sources, and it reads the best pages in full.
form.allowWeb: Also search the web when my documents are included
form.allowWebHint: Off by default: once your documents are read, a page on the web could be used to carry their contents out. Turn this on only if you trust the question.

web.available: Web search runs on your own search key.
web.missing: No web search key is connected, so research runs on your knowledge base only (KB-only).
web.keyless: No search key is connected, so the web is searched through DuckDuckGo. It needs no key but can be slow or refuse; a Tavily or Brave key is more reliable.

kbOnly.noSearchKey: KB-only: no web search key is connected.
kbOnly.webOff: KB-only: the web stays off once your documents are included, unless you allow it.
kbOnly.generic: KB-only: this report did not use the web.

report.engineKeyless: Web searched through DuckDuckGo (no search key).

errors.failed: The research could not be started.

check.title: Claim check
check.summary: {{supported}} of {{total}} claims are supported by the sources they cite.
check.allSupported: Every checked claim is supported by the source it cites.
check.caveat: Checked by an AI against the cited text, not proof that a claim is true. Open the source before you rely on a claim, especially one marked below.
check.unavailable: The claim check could not run for this report, so nothing in it has been checked.

open.title: Worth researching next
open.body: Gaps the search still saw when it stopped.

keep.title: Keep studying this
keep.body: Add the report to a knowledge base and it becomes a document like any other: quiz yourself on it, build a mastery path, or ask about it in chat.
keep.includeSources: Also add the web pages it cites
keep.includeSourcesHint: Each page is fetched once and indexed with your embedding model, so its passages can be cited later.
keep.added: Added to {{kb}}. Indexing takes a moment.
keep.pages: {{added}} page(s) added, {{already}} already there, {{failed}} could not be read.
keep.noKbs: You have no knowledge base yet.
